race.comment: RONALDO JACK (2) wasn't far away at the finish when 5th and beaten only 4.5 lengths (17.12) at Healesville. Comes out of a hot form race last start. Should be very hard to beat this time. SEKIRO (4) is an honest type in the frame at five of 10 starts including last time when third (22.74) over 390m at this track. Has a good overall strike-rate and can find the frame here. HEAVEN ON EARTH (6) has been settling off the speed lately, finishing fourth (24.54) last time in a T3 RSTW at Bendigo. Cannot be underestimated. SCOTT IMPOSTER (1) warrants respect with the drop in distance.
